title: Professional and academic life
objectives: Run through a meeting agenda, report progress, and record minutes in Tagalog
Deliver a short presentation with standard opening, transition and closing phrases
Talk about deadlines, tasks and responsibilities in the office and at university
Understand Taglish code-switching in professional settings — and judge when to avoid it

grammar.title: Meeting language: the pulong from start to adjournment
grammar.explanation:
A Tagalog-language meeting (pulong) has its own liturgy. Opening: Simulan na natin ang pulong 'let's start the meeting'; Nandito ba ang lahat? / Kumpleto na ba tayo? checks quorum. The agenda is adyenda or mga paksang tatalakayin 'topics to be discussed': Tatlo ang paksa natin ngayon 'we have three topics today'. Moving through it: Sa unang paksa... 'on the first topic'; Lumipat tayo sa susunod na paksa 'let's move to the next topic'; Bumalik tayo rito mamaya 'let's come back to this later'.

Reporting progress leans on the abilitative and the pa/na particle system you know: Natapos na namin ang disenyo 'we've finished the design'; Hindi pa natatapos ang pagsusuri, pero malapit na 'the review isn't done yet, but it's close'; May naiwang isyu tayo noong nakaraang pulong 'we have an issue left over from the last meeting'.

Closing: May iba pa bang nais talakayin? 'anything else to discuss?'; Kung wala na, itinataas ko na ang pulong — the fixed phrase for adjournment, literally 'I raise the meeting'; more common: Tapos na ang pulong. Maraming salamat sa lahat. Decisions are recorded as napagkasunduan 'what was agreed': Napagkasunduang ilipat ang deadline sa Biyernes.

grammar.title: Minutes, memos and the language of tasks
grammar.explanation:
Minutes (katitikan ng pulong) are written in the formal register of Unit 6, heavy on object-focus completed verbs and ay-inversion: Ang pulong ay pinangunahan ni Gng. Cruz 'the meeting was chaired by Mrs. Cruz'; Iniulat ni G. Santos na... 'Mr. Santos reported that...'; Inaprubahan ang badyet para sa... 'the budget for... was approved'. Assignments use the benefactive-flavored frame Naatasan si X na + verb 'X was tasked to...': Naatasan si Bb. Reyes na maghanda ng ulat — 'Miss Reyes was tasked to prepare the report.'

Deadline vocabulary: takdang oras / takdang araw 'set time/day', huling araw ng pagpapasa 'last day of submission', palugit 'extension / grace period' (Humingi kami ng tatlong araw na palugit 'we asked for a three-day extension'), abot o lampas sa takda 'within or past the deadline'. Academic life shares the set: pagsusumite ng papel 'submission of the paper', pagtatanggol ng tesis 'thesis defense', konsultasyon 'consultation hours'.

Note how much of this is Unit 2 nominalization at work: paghahanda, pagsusuri, pagpapasa, pagtatanggol. Professional Tagalog is gerund-dense — one more reason that pattern earned a whole unit.

grammar.title: Taglish at the office: an honest guide
grammar.explanation:
In real Philippine offices, meetings run in Taglish: I-forward mo na lang sa akin ang file, tapos i-cc mo si ma'am 'just forward me the file, then cc ma'am'. The grammar is systematic, not lazy: English verbs enter through the i- object-focus slot (i-print, i-schedule, i-approve) or the mag- actor slot (mag-adjust, mag-follow up), and conjugate regularly: ni-review ko na, ipa-print natin... more precisely: ipapa-print with the causative. English nouns take Tagalog markers: ang meeting, sa deadline, ng report. Nobody blinks.

When do you avoid it? Formal writing, always — the minutes say pinag-aralan, not ni-review. Speeches, official letters, government documents: pure Filipino or pure English, not the blend. With elders and in provinces where Tagalog is a second language, heavy Taglish can read as Manila-centric showing off. And in an exam certifying your Tagalog, obviously, the target language is the one being tested.

The strategic view: code-switching is itself a register skill. A B2 speaker should understand office Taglish at full speed, produce it when the room does, and be able to switch to pure Tagalog on demand — for the visiting official, the formal presentation, the written record. The failure mode is not Taglish itself; it is having no other gear.

dialogue.title: Lingguhang pulong ng koponan
dialogue.context: Team lead Carmen runs the weekly status meeting; Bok and Dess report progress, in the mixed register of a real Manila office — then Carmen switches registers for the record.

lines.speaker: Carmen
lines.tl: Kumpleto na tayo? Sige, simulan na natin. Tatlo ang paksa natin: ang website, ang badyet, at ang team building.
lines.en: Are we complete? Alright, let's start. We have three topics: the website, the budget, and the team building.

lines.speaker: Bok
lines.tl: Sa website: natapos na namin ang disenyo, pero hindi pa natatapos ang testing. Baka matapos sa Huwebes.
lines.en: On the website: we've finished the design, but testing isn't done yet. It might be finished by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Carmen
lines.tl: Huwebes? Biyernes ang takdang araw sa kliyente. May palugit ba tayo kung sakali?
lines.en: Thursday? The client deadline is Friday. Do we have a grace period, just in case?

lines.speaker: Bok
lines.tl: Wala na po. Pero kaya naman; i-poprioritize namin ang testing bukas.
lines.en: None left. But we can manage; we'll prioritize the testing tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Dess
lines.tl: Sa badyet naman: na-approve na ng finance ang dagdag na pondo, pero kulang pa rin para sa bagong laptop ni Bok.
lines.en: On the budget: finance approved the additional funds, but it's still short for Bok's new laptop.

lines.speaker: Carmen
lines.tl: Sige, ako na ang magfa-follow up kay Sir Nestor. Pansamantala, gamitin muna ni Bok ang spare unit.
lines.en: Alright, I'll follow up with Sir Nestor. Meanwhile, Bok can use the spare unit for now.

lines.speaker: Dess
lines.tl: Isusulat ko ba sa katitikan na 'magfa-follow up si Ma'am Carmen'?
lines.en: Should I write in the minutes that 'Ma'am Carmen will follow up'?

lines.speaker: Carmen
lines.tl: Naku, huwag ganyan ang wika sa katitikan. Isulat mo: 'Naatasan si Gng. Carmen Uy na makipag-ugnayan sa Tanggapan ng Pananalapi hinggil sa karagdagang pondo.'
lines.en: Oh no, not that language in the minutes. Write: 'Mrs. Carmen Uy was tasked to coordinate with the Finance Office regarding the additional funds.'

lines.speaker: Dess
lines.tl: Opo. Iba talaga ang Tagalog ng katitikan sa Tagalog ng usapan, ano po?
lines.en: Yes. The Tagalog of minutes really is different from the Tagalog of conversation, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Carmen
lines.tl: Ganyan talaga. Sa usapan, Taglish tayo; sa papel, pormal. Huling paksa: napagkasunduan ba nating sa Tagaytay ang team building?
lines.en: That's how it is. In conversation, we're in Taglish; on paper, formal. Last topic: did we agree the team building is in Tagaytay?

lines.speaker: Bok
lines.tl: Opo, at humingi na ako ng quotation sa resort. Ipapasa ko sa inyo mamaya.
lines.en: Yes, and I've requested a quotation from the resort. I'll send it to you later.

lines.speaker: Carmen
lines.tl: Mahusay. Kung wala nang iba, itinataas ko na ang pulong. Salamat sa lahat!
lines.en: Excellent. If there's nothing else, the meeting is adjourned. Thanks, everyone!

reading.title: Katitikan ng Pulong ng Sangay ng Pagpaplano
reading.tl:
KATITIKAN NG PULONG
Sangay ng Pagpaplano, Ika-17 ng Agosto, 2026, 2:00 n.h., Silid-Pulungan B

Mga dumalo: Gng. Carmen Uy (tagapangulo), G. Roberto Reyes, Bb. Dess Ocampo, G. Bok Villanueva. Hindi nakadalo: G. Nestor Lim (nasa opisyal na biyahe).

Binuksan ni Gng. Uy ang pulong sa ganap na 2:05 n.h. Binasa at inaprubahan ang katitikan ng nakaraang pulong nang walang pagbabago.

Sa unang paksa, iniulat ni G. Villanueva na natapos na ang disenyo ng bagong website ngunit hindi pa tapos ang pagsusuri nito. Napagkasunduang unahin ang pagsusuri upang maabot ang takdang araw sa darating na Biyernes. Naatasan si G. Villanueva na magbigay ng pang-araw-araw na ulat hanggang sa pagpapasa.

Sa ikalawang paksa, ibinahagi ni Bb. Ocampo na inaprubahan na ng Tanggapan ng Pananalapi ang karagdagang pondo, subalit kulang pa ito para sa pagbili ng bagong kagamitan. Naatasan si Gng. Uy na makipag-ugnayan sa Tanggapan ng Pananalapi hinggil dito. Pansamantalang gagamitin ang nakalaang ekstrang kagamitan.

Sa ikatlong paksa, pinagtibay ang Tagaytay bilang lugar ng gaganaping team building sa Oktubre. Naatasan si G. Villanueva na kumuha ng pormal na quotation mula sa napiling resort at iharap ito sa susunod na pulong.

Sa kawalan ng iba pang paksa, itinaas ang pulong sa ganap na 3:20 n.h. Ang susunod na pulong ay gaganapin sa ika-24 ng Agosto, 2026.

Inihanda ni: Bb. Dess Ocampo, Kalihim
Binigyang-pansin at pinagtibay ni: Gng. Carmen Uy, Tagapangulo
reading.en:
MINUTES OF THE MEETING
Planning Division, August 17, 2026, 2:00 p.m., Meeting Room B

Present: Mrs. Carmen Uy (chair), Mr. Roberto Reyes, Miss Dess Ocampo, Mr. Bok Villanueva. Absent: Mr. Nestor Lim (on official travel).

Mrs. Uy opened the meeting at exactly 2:05 p.m. The minutes of the previous meeting were read and approved without changes.

On the first topic, Mr. Villanueva reported that the design of the new website is finished but its review is not yet complete. It was agreed to prioritize the review in order to meet this coming Friday's deadline. Mr. Villanueva was tasked to give a daily report until submission.

On the second topic, Miss Ocampo shared that the Finance Office has approved the additional funds, but they are still insufficient for the purchase of new equipment. Mrs. Uy was tasked to coordinate with the Finance Office regarding this. The reserved spare equipment will be used in the meantime.

On the third topic, Tagaytay was confirmed as the venue of the team building to be held in October. Mr. Villanueva was tasked to obtain a formal quotation from the chosen resort and present it at the next meeting.

There being no other topics, the meeting was adjourned at exactly 3:20 p.m. The next meeting will be held on August 24, 2026.

Prepared by: Miss Dess Ocampo, Secretary
Noted and confirmed by: Mrs. Carmen Uy, Chair

gloss.en: to coordinate, get in touch with

choices: the meeting agenda
the minutes of the meeting
the attendance sheet
the meeting room
exercises.explain: Katitikan ng pulong is the official minutes. The agenda is the adyenda; attendance is the listahan ng mga dumalo.

exercises.prompt: Kung wala nang iba pang paksa, ___ ko na ang pulong. (the fixed adjournment verb)
exercises.explain: Itinataas ko na ang pulong — literally 'I now raise the meeting' — is the fixed formula for adjournment.

exercises.prompt: Naatasan si Bb. Reyes na maghanda ng ulat. What does this minutes-line mean?
choices: Miss Reyes refused to prepare the report.
Miss Reyes was tasked to prepare the report.
Miss Reyes already submitted the report.
Miss Reyes chaired the meeting about the report.
exercises.explain: Naatasan (from atasan 'to task someone') + na + verb is the standard assignment formula in minutes: 'was tasked to prepare the report'.

exercises.prompt: Hindi namin aabutin ang takdang araw. Puwede po bang humingi ng tatlong araw na ___? (extension)
exercises.explain: Palugit is an extension or grace period on a deadline: humingi ng palugit = 'to ask for an extension'.

exercises.prompt: In office Taglish, how does the English verb 'print' most naturally take the causative 'have it printed'?
choices: ipa-print natin
pag-print tayo ito
print-in natin siya
na-print kami nito
exercises.explain: English verbs slot into Tagalog affix frames: ipa- (causative i- + pa-) gives ipa-print 'have it printed', exactly parallel to ipagawa, ipaluto.

exercises.tl: Ipinagpaliban ang pulong sa Lunes dahil nasa opisyal na biyahe ang direktor.
choices: It was postponed to Monday because the director is on official travel.
It was moved to today because the director returned.
It was canceled because nobody attended.
It was extended because the director had many topics.
exercises.explain: Ipinagpaliban = 'was postponed'; sa Lunes gives the new day; dahil nasa opisyal na biyahe explains why.

exercises.prompt: It was agreed to move the deadline to Friday.
exercises.answer: Napagkasunduang ilipat ang takdang araw sa Biyernes.
accept: Napagkasunduang ilipat ang takdang araw sa Biyernes
Napagkasunduan na ilipat ang takdang araw sa Biyernes
Napagkasunduang ilipat sa Biyernes ang takdang araw
exercises.explain: Napagkasunduan(g) + infinitive records a collective decision — the standard minutes formula for agreements.

exercises.prompt: Iniulat ni G. Santos na hindi pa natatapos ang pagsusuri, ngunit maaabot pa rin ang takdang araw.
exercises.answer: Mr. Santos reported that the review is not yet finished, but the deadline can still be met.
accept: Mr. Santos reported that the review is not yet finished, but the deadline can still be met
Mr. Santos reported that the review isn't done yet but the deadline will still be met
Mr. Santos reported that the evaluation is not yet complete, but they can still meet the deadline
exercises.explain: Iniulat ni X na... attributes the report; hindi pa natatapos is the incompleted abilitative 'not yet finished'; maaabot ang takdang araw = 'the deadline can be reached'.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence belongs in written minutes rather than spoken discussion?
choices: I-follow up mo na lang kay finance, ha?
Ang pulong ay pinangunahan ni Gng. Cruz.
Tapos na ba 'yung sa website?
Sige, ako na bahala diyan.
exercises.explain: Minutes use formal register with ay-inversion and full names/titles: Ang pulong ay pinangunahan ni Gng. Cruz. The others are spoken office Taglish and casual talk.

exercises.prompt: From the reading: what will Mr. Villanueva do about the team building?
choices: Cancel it due to budget
Obtain a formal quotation from the resort and present it at the next meeting
Chair the next meeting in Tagaytay
Ask the Finance Office for a new laptop
exercises.explain: The minutes record: Naatasan si G. Villanueva na kumuha ng pormal na quotation... at iharap ito sa susunod na pulong.

exercises.tl: Magandang umaga sa inyong lahat. Sa unang bahagi ng aking paglalahad, tatalakayin ko ang kasaysayan ng proyekto.
choices: Opening a presentation and previewing its first part
Closing a presentation and thanking the audience
Interrupting someone else's presentation
Postponing the presentation to another day
exercises.explain: The greeting plus sa unang bahagi ng aking paglalahad ('in the first part of my presentation') and tatalakayin ko ('I will discuss') is a standard presentation opening.

exercises.prompt: The professor gave us a one-week extension for the submission of the research paper.
exercises.answer: Binigyan kami ng propesor ng isang linggong palugit para sa pagpapasa ng papel ng pananaliksik.
accept: Binigyan kami ng propesor ng isang linggong palugit para sa pagpapasa ng papel ng pananaliksik
Binigyan kami ng propesor ng isang linggong palugit sa pagpapasa ng research paper
Binigyan kami ng propesor ng palugit na isang linggo para sa pagpapasa ng papel ng pananaliksik
exercises.explain: Binigyan (Unit 1's -an recipient focus!) puts 'us' in focus; palugit is the extension; pagpapasa is the Unit 2-style gerund for submission.
